blocks.content: 4. Recap: What validate Genuinely Checks
Recall from the CLI module, validate checks syntax and internal consistency, genuinely not real-world, live infrastructure correctness at all.
This honest limitation is worth restating directly here, validate passing does not genuinely guarantee a real apply will actually succeed.
A wrong AMI ID, for instance, might pass validate entirely, since it is syntactically valid, while still genuinely failing at real apply time.
Understanding this honest boundary is what makes the next section's guidance, going beyond validate, make real, practical sense.
